author: mr_blue2i2
quote: 13 years for this absolute garbage. That fake 99 Metascore is the biggest joke in gaming history. Rockstar took over a decade just to serve us a boring, bloated walking simulator with zero soul, brain-dead linear missions from 2005, and watered-down writing afraid to offend anyone. Terrible performance, recycled mechanics, and holding the PC version hostage just to double-dip on fans. Pure corporate greed disguised as a 'masterpiece.' Save your money
